interpretation_rules.zero_crossing_wording: compatible with zero, not proof of no effect and not equivalence

statistics.break_even_definition: N* = C/Q with Q = observed mean candidate-vs-base effect and C = combined mean migration cost of the matching single-swap transaction for the same capture; Fieller-type ratio interval treating the two campaigns as independent (se from the frozen t intervals); computed only when CI(Q) excludes zero and mean Q > 0
statistics.effect_definition: block effect = completion_fenced_us_per_forward(base) - completion_fenced_us_per_forward(candidate) within the same randomized block; start-level effect = mean of the five block effects; inferential sample = four independent starts; two-sided 95% Student-t interval, df=3
statistics.migration_cost_definition: per start, per transaction: mean of the 50 forward walls, mean of the 50 reverse walls, and combined = mean of the two; n=4 start-level values; t interval df=3; primary C = combined mean; forward and reverse reported separately
statistics.sign_convention: positive effect = candidate faster than base (Q = T_base - T_candidate)
